description: Latest official macroeconomic numbers for a country, refreshed daily from primary sources (OECD, BIS, IMF World Economic Outlook, World Bank, Eurostat): inflation (CPI y/y), central bank policy rate, unemployment rate, real GDP growth (quarterly y/y), IMF annual GDP growth and inflation incl. forecasts, population. Returns value, reference period, previous value, source and a citable URL. Omit country to get one indicator for all countries (ranked).

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. 'Germany', 'DE', 'USA', 'euro area'. Omit to list all countries for one indicator.

history.description: Include the full recent time series (up to 60 observations) for the chosen indicator.

indicator.description: Which indicator (default 'all' for a country; 'inflation' when listing all countries).

name: latest_indicator
